name: JIANKUN
recent: Jiankun International Berhad 在最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收环比增长354.6%至278.7万令吉，但净亏损29.9万令吉。公司近期出现董事会变动，张军（MR ZHANG, JUN）于2026年11月11日辞任/调任董事，公司秘书亦于9月底变更。此外，一名执行董事在闭市期前表示有意交易公司证券。
notable: 截至2026年6月30日季度营收环比增长354.6%至278.7万令吉，但净亏损29.9万令吉。
执行董事兼首席执行官Edwin Silverster Das等董事在闭市期前表示有意交易公司证券。
公司秘书Thien Lee Mee于2026年9月30日变更。
risks: 最新季度仍录得净亏损29.9万令吉，净利率为-10.7%。
董事在闭市期前表示有意交易公司证券，可能涉及股权变动。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度营收为278.7万令吉，环比增长354.6%，同比增长94.8%；净亏损29.9万令吉，净利率-10.7%，较上一季度的-151.7%有所收窄。

recent_en: Jiankun International Berhad reported revenue of RM2.787 million for the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, up 354.6% QoQ, but recorded a net loss of RM299,000. The company saw a boardroom change with MR ZHANG, JUN on 11 November 2026 and a change of company secretary in late September. An executive director also indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
notable_en: Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 354.6% QoQ to RM2.787 million, but a net loss of RM299,000 was recorded.
Executive Director/CEO Edwin Silverster Das and other directors indicated intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
Change of company secretary, Thien Lee Mee, effective 30 September 2026.
risks_en: The latest quarter remained loss-making with a net loss of RM299,000 and a net margin of -10.7%.
Directors indicated intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period, which may involve changes in shareholdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2.787 million, up 354.6% QoQ and 94.8% YoY; net loss was RM299,000 with a net margin of -10.7%, narrowing from -151.7% in the previous quarter.
